blocks.html: RLC Residences was once again awarded with an international recognition by the European Society for Quality Research (ESQR) last December 10 at Dusit Thani Dubai.

The residential division of Robinsons Land, along with other awardees from different countries and industries, were recognized by the award-giving body, aiming to recognize outstanding business results, best practices, quality awareness and achievements across the globe. Represented by RLC Residences Dubai Branch Head Mari Lorinie Catabay, RLC Residences proudly received the trophy from the organizers.

“We are grateful to be recognized in the international scene for our business practices and efforts in building and developing beautiful, well-designed condominiums in the Philippines. On behalf of RLC Residences, we thank the European Society for Quality Research for this citation and for validating all the hard work the whole team have been doing for years,” said Catabay in a statement.

European Society for Quality Research is an international organization with a Head Office in Lausanne, Switzerland that aims to promote quality awareness, recognize good business practices, technological innovation, quality achievements in companies, public administrations and organizations worldwide, and publicize their successful performance strategies.
